#Reading in the Data
``` {r reading in data for brain neg}
#Reading in MZmine CSV export
brain_neg_raw_data <- read.csv("brain_neg_metaboanalyst.csv", 
                     header = FALSE, 
                     check.names = FALSE, 
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Getting sample names and conditions
brain_neg_sample_names <- as.character(brain_neg_raw_data[1, -1])
brain_neg_groups <- as.character(brain_neg_raw_data[2, -1])

#Creating metadata table
brain_neg_metadata <- tibble(
  Sample = brain_neg_sample_names,
  Group  = brain_neg_groups
) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Control", "0 hr", "1 hr", "2 hr", "4 hr", "8 hr", "24 hr")),
    Group_clean = make.names(Group)
  )
```

#Running PCA and PLS-DA
``` {r pipeline for all PCAs and PLS-DAs}
pca_plsda_function <- function(raw_data, metadata, out_dir, norm_standard, exclude_features, title) {
  
  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  #Feature matrix
  features_raw <- raw_data[-c(1, 2), ]
  feature_ids <- as.character(features_raw[[1]])
  intensity_matrix <- features_raw[, -1]
  
  sample_names <- as.character(raw_data[1, -1])
  
  intensity_matrix <- intensity_matrix %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ .x %>%
                    str_replace_all(",", "") %>%
                    str_trim() %>%
                    as.numeric()
    ))
  
  colnames(intensity_matrix) <- sample_names
  rownames(intensity_matrix) <- feature_ids
  
  #Filter: ≥50% detection in at least one group
  intensity_matrix_long <- intensity_matrix %>%
    mutate(feature_ids = rownames(intensity_matrix)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -feature_ids,
                 names_to = "Sample",
                 values_to = "Intensity") %>%
    left_join(metadata, by = "Sample") %>%
    mutate(Intensity = replace_na(Intensity, 0))
  
  keep_features <- intensity_matrix_long %>%
    group_by(feature_ids, Group) %>%
    summarize(prop_nonzero = mean(Intensity > 0, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(feature_ids) %>%
    summarise(keep = any(prop_nonzero >= 0.5), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(keep == TRUE) %>%
    pull(feature_ids)
  
  #Remove internal standards from analysis
  intensity_matrix_filtered <- intensity_matrix %>%
    rownames_to_column("feature_ids") %>%
    filter(feature_ids %in% keep_features) %>%
    { if (!is.null(exclude_features)) filter(., !feature_ids %in% exclude_features) else . } %>%
    column_to_rownames("feature_ids")
  
 #LOD/2 imputation on raw intensities (LOD = minimum detected raw intensity)
  intensity_matrix_filtered_numeric <- as.matrix(intensity_matrix_filtered)
  
  lod <- min(intensity_matrix_filtered_numeric[intensity_matrix_filtered_numeric > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  intensity_matrix_filtered_numeric[is.na(intensity_matrix_filtered_numeric) |
                                    intensity_matrix_filtered_numeric == 0] <- lod / 2
  
  #Normalize by internal standard
  internal_standard <- intensity_matrix[norm_standard, ] %>%
    as.numeric()
  
  intensity_matrix_imputed <- sweep(intensity_matrix_filtered_numeric, 2, internal_standard, "/") %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  #Log2 transform + scale for PCA
  pca_data <- intensity_matrix_imputed %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), log2)) %>%
    as.matrix() %>%
    t() %>%
    scale()
  
  #Log2 transform only for PLS-DA
  plsda_data <- intensity_matrix_imputed %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), log2)) %>%
    as.matrix() %>%
    t()
  
  #PCA
  pca_res <- prcomp(pca_data, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
  
  pca_scores <- pca_res$x %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
    left_join(metadata, by = "Sample")
  
  var_explained <- (pca_res$sdev^2) / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)
  
  #PCA plot
  pca_plot <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    stat_ellipse(aes(group = Group), linetype = 2, level = 0.95) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_explained[1] * 100, 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_explained[2] * 100, 1), "%)"),
      title = paste0("PCA \u2014 ", title)
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "PCA_plot.jpg"), pca_plot, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  
  #Scree plot
  scree_df <- data.frame(
    PC = seq_along(var_explained),
    Variance = var_explained * 100
  )
  
  scree_plot <- ggplot(scree_df[1:min(10, nrow(scree_df)), ], aes(x = PC, y = Variance)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_line(color = "black") +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    labs(
      x = "Principal Component",
      y = "Variance Explained (%)",
      title = paste0("Scree Plot \u2014 ", title)
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "scree_plot.jpg"), scree_plot, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  
  #PLS-DA using log2-transformed data
  X <- plsda_data
  Y <- metadata$Group
  
  set.seed(123)
  plsda_res <- mixOmics::plsda(X, Y, ncomp = 2)
  
  #PLS-DA plot
  jpeg(file.path(out_dir, "PLSDA_plot.jpg"), width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300)
  plotIndiv(plsda_res,
            comp = c(1, 2),
            group = Y,
            legend = TRUE,
            ellipse = TRUE,
            ind.names = FALSE,
            title = paste0("PLS-DA \u2014 ", title))
  dev.off()
  
  #PLS-DA cross-validation via perf() to assess model performance
  set.seed(123)
  plsda_perf <- mixOmics::perf(plsda_res,
                                validation = "Mfold",
                                folds = 5,
                                nrepeat = 50,
                                progressBar = FALSE)
  
  #Cross-validation error rate plot
  jpeg(file.path(out_dir, "PLSDA_perf_plot.jpg"), width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300)
  plot(plsda_perf, main = paste0("PLS-DA Cross-Validation \u2014 ", title))
  dev.off()
  
  #VIP scores for all features
  vip_scores <- mixOmics::vip(plsda_res)
  
  vip_scores_table <- vip_scores %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("feature_ids") %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      feature_ids,
      VIP = comp1
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(VIP))
  
  #VIP plot - top 20 features
  vip_plot <- vip_scores_table %>%
    slice_head(n = 20) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = VIP, y = reorder(feature_ids, VIP))) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    labs(
      x = "VIP Score",
      y = "Feature",
      title = paste0("Top 20 VIP Scores \u2014 ", title)
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "VIP_plot.jpg"), vip_plot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  
  message("Done: ", title)
}
```

#Pairwise Comparisons (mzmine-style)
``` {r t-test and volcano plot function}
ttest_volcano_function <- function(raw_data, metadata, out_dir, norm_standard, exclude_features, title) {
  
  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  #Feature matrix
  features_raw <- raw_data[-c(1, 2), ]
  feature_ids <- as.character(features_raw[[1]])
  intensity_matrix <- features_raw[, -1]
  
  sample_names <- as.character(raw_data[1, -1])
  
  intensity_matrix <- intensity_matrix %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ .x %>%
                    str_replace_all(",", "") %>%
                    str_trim() %>%
                    as.numeric()
    ))
  
  colnames(intensity_matrix) <- sample_names
  rownames(intensity_matrix) <- feature_ids
  
  #Filter: ≥50% detection in at least one group
  intensity_matrix_long <- intensity_matrix %>%
    mutate(feature_ids = rownames(intensity_matrix)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -feature_ids,
                 names_to = "Sample",
                 values_to = "Intensity") %>%
    left_join(metadata, by = "Sample") %>%
    mutate(Intensity = replace_na(Intensity, 0))
  
  keep_features <- intensity_matrix_long %>%
    group_by(feature_ids, Group) %>%
    summarize(prop_nonzero = mean(Intensity > 0, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(feature_ids) %>%
    summarise(keep = any(prop_nonzero >= 0.5), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(keep == TRUE) %>%
    pull(feature_ids)
  
  #Remove internal standards from analysis
  intensity_matrix_filtered <- intensity_matrix %>%
    rownames_to_column("feature_ids") %>%
    filter(feature_ids %in% keep_features) %>%
    { if (!is.null(exclude_features)) filter(., !feature_ids %in% exclude_features) else . } %>%
    column_to_rownames("feature_ids")
  
   #LOD/2 imputation on raw intensities (LOD = minimum detected raw intensity)
  intensity_matrix_filtered_numeric <- as.matrix(intensity_matrix_filtered)
  
  lod <- min(intensity_matrix_filtered_numeric[intensity_matrix_filtered_numeric > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  intensity_matrix_filtered_numeric[is.na(intensity_matrix_filtered_numeric) |
                                    intensity_matrix_filtered_numeric == 0] <- lod / 2
  
  #Normalize by internal standard
  internal_standard <- intensity_matrix[norm_standard, ] %>%
    as.numeric()
  
  intensity_matrix_imputed <- sweep(intensity_matrix_filtered_numeric, 2, internal_standard, "/") %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  #Log2 transform
  intensity_matrix_log <- intensity_matrix_imputed %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), log2))
  
  #Welch's t-tests for all pairwise comparisons
  group_levels <- levels(metadata$Group)
  pairwise_combos <- combn(group_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  
  all_results <- pairwise_combos %>%
    map_dfr(function(pair) {
      
      g1 <- pair[2]
      g2 <- pair[1]
      contrast_name <- paste0(g1, "_vs_", g2)
      
      message("Running: ", contrast_name)
      
      #Get sample names for each group
      samples_g1 <- metadata %>% filter(Group == g1) %>% pull(Sample)
      samples_g2 <- metadata %>% filter(Group == g2) %>% pull(Sample)
      
      #Run Welch's t-test per feature
      results <- intensity_matrix_log %>%
        rownames_to_column("feature_ids") %>%
        rowwise() %>%
        mutate(
          vals_g1 = list(as.numeric(c_across(all_of(samples_g1)))),
          vals_g2 = list(as.numeric(c_across(all_of(samples_g2)))),
          mean_g1 = mean(unlist(vals_g1), na.rm = TRUE),
          mean_g2 = mean(unlist(vals_g2), na.rm = TRUE),
          logFC   = mean_g1 - mean_g2,
          t.score = tryCatch(
            t.test(unlist(vals_g1), unlist(vals_g2), var.equal = FALSE)$statistic,
            error = function(e) NA_real_
          ),
          p.value = tryCatch(
            t.test(unlist(vals_g1), unlist(vals_g2), var.equal = FALSE)$p.value,
            error = function(e) NA_real_
          )
        ) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(
          adj.p.value = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
          negLogP = -log10(p.value),
          Significance = case_when(
            adj.p.value < 0.05 ~ "FDR < 0.05",
            p.value < 0.05     ~ "p < 0.05",
            TRUE               ~ "p \u2265 0.05"
          ),
          Contrast = contrast_name
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(feature_ids, logFC, t.score, p.value, adj.p.value, negLogP, Significance, Contrast)
      
      #Volcano plot
      p_volc <- results %>%
        filter(!is.na(p.value)) %>%
        ggplot(aes(logFC, negLogP, color = Significance)) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c(
          "p \u2265 0.05" = "black",
          "p < 0.05"     = "blue",
          "FDR < 0.05"   = "red"
        )) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 2, color = "blue") +
        labs(
          title = paste("Volcano:", contrast_name),
          x = "log2 Fold Change",
          y = "-log10(P-value)"
        ) +
        theme_minimal()
      
      ggsave(
        file.path(out_dir, paste0("Volcano_", contrast_name, ".jpg")),
        plot = p_volc,
        width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300
      )
      
      #Save all results per contrast
      write.csv(
        results,
        file.path(out_dir, paste0("All_Features_", contrast_name, ".csv")),
        row.names = FALSE
      )
      
      results
    })
  
  #Save combined results
  all_results_wide <- all_results %>%
    dplyr::select(feature_ids, Contrast, logFC, p.value, adj.p.value) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from  = Contrast,
      values_from = c(logFC, p.value, adj.p.value),
      names_glue  = "{Contrast}_{.value}"
    )
  
  write.csv(
    all_results_wide,
    file.path(out_dir, "All_Features_Combined.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  message("Done: ", title)
  return(all_results)
}
```

#Prepare Data for Metaboanalyst Analysis
``` {r mummichog prep}
mummichog_prep_function <- function(results, title, mummichog_dir, mode) {
  
  dir.create(mummichog_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  #Filter for Control vs 4 hr and parse m/z and RT from feature_ids
  mummichog_table <- results %>%
    filter(Contrast == "4 hr_vs_Control") %>%
    filter(!is.na(p.value)) %>%
    mutate(
      parts   = purrr::map(feature_ids, ~ str_trim(str_split(.x, "/")[[1]])),
      RT      = purrr::map_chr(parts, ~ .x[length(.x)]),
      m_z_raw = purrr::map_chr(parts, ~ .x[length(.x) - 1]),
      m.z     = as.numeric(str_remove(m_z_raw, "mz")),
      r.t     = as.numeric(str_remove(RT, "min")),
      mode    = mode
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(m.z, r.t, p.value, t.score, mode)
  
  #Export individual mode file
  write.table(
    mummichog_table,
    file = file.path(mummichog_dir, paste0(title, "_4hr_vs_Control.txt")),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  message("Done: ", title)
  
  return(mummichog_table)
}

#Run mummichog prep and store results
brain_neg_mummichog <- mummichog_prep_function(brain_neg_results, "brain_neg", "mummichog_input", mode = "negative")
brain_pos_mummichog <- mummichog_prep_function(brain_pos_results, "brain_pos", "mummichog_input", mode = "positive")
liver_neg_mummichog <- mummichog_prep_function(liver_neg_results, "liver_neg", "mummichog_input", mode = "negative")
liver_pos_mummichog <- mummichog_prep_function(liver_pos_results, "liver_pos", "mummichog_input", mode = "positive")

#Create mixed mode files by combining neg and pos for brain and liver
brain_mixed <- bind_rows(brain_neg_mummichog, brain_pos_mummichog)
liver_mixed <- bind_rows(liver_neg_mummichog, liver_pos_mummichog)

write.table(
  brain_mixed,
  file = file.path("mummichog_input", "brain_mixed_4hr_vs_Control.txt"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  liver_mixed,
  file = file.path("mummichog_input", "liver_mixed_4hr_vs_Control.txt"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

``` {r p-values for Metaboanalyst}
#Calculate p-value cutoff for top 10% of features for each dataset
brain_neg_cutoff <- quantile(brain_neg_mummichog$p.value, probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)
brain_pos_cutoff <- quantile(brain_pos_mummichog$p.value, probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)
liver_neg_cutoff <- quantile(liver_neg_mummichog$p.value, probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)
liver_pos_cutoff <- quantile(liver_pos_mummichog$p.value, probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)
brain_mixed_cutoff <- quantile(brain_mixed$p.value, probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)
liver_mixed_cutoff <- quantile(liver_mixed$p.value, probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)

print(brain_neg_cutoff)
print(brain_pos_cutoff)
print(liver_neg_cutoff)
print(liver_pos_cutoff)
print(brain_mixed_cutoff)
print(liver_mixed_cutoff)

beep()
```

#Extra
``` {r feature plot - unknown chlorinated compound}
feature_boxplot <- function(raw_data, metadata, feature_id, norm_standard = NULL,
                            y_label = "Peak Area", title = feature_id, out_file = NULL) {
  
  #Helper: convert a row of the raw CSV to numbers
  to_num <- function(row) {
    row %>% unlist() %>% as.character() %>%
      str_replace_all(",", "") %>% str_trim() %>% as.numeric()
  }
  
  sample_names <- as.character(raw_data[1, -1])
  ids <- str_trim(as.character(raw_data[[1]]))
  
  if (!feature_id %in% ids) stop("Feature not found: ", feature_id)
  
  values <- to_num(raw_data[ids == feature_id, -1])
  
  #Optional: normalize to internal standard
  if (!is.null(norm_standard)) {
    if (!norm_standard %in% ids) stop("Internal standard not found: ", norm_standard)
    values <- values / to_num(raw_data[ids == norm_standard, -1])
    y_label <- paste0(y_label, " (normalized to IS)")
  }
  
  #Treat 0 as not detected so it isn't plotted
  plot_df <- tibble(Sample = sample_names, Intensity = values) %>%
    left_join(metadata, by = "Sample") %>%
    mutate(Intensity = if_else(Intensity == 0, NA_real_, Intensity))
  
  #Report how many samples per group were detected
  plot_df %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    summarise(detected = sum(!is.na(Intensity)), total = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    print()
  
  p <- plot_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Intensity)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Group, y = Intensity, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_scientific()) +
    labs(x = "Condition", y = y_label, title = title) +
    theme_prism(base_size = 14, base_fontface = "plain") +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.text  = element_text(size = 10))
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  if (!is.null(out_file)) ggsave(out_file, p, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  
  p
}

feature_boxplot(brain_neg_raw_data, brain_neg_metadata,
                feature_id = "2153/116.9072mz/4.02min",
                title = "m/z 116.9072 — Brain (Negative Mode)",
                out_file = "boxplots/brain_neg_116.9072.jpg")
```
